scientific_integrity: All universal claims have explicit analytic proofs and are supported by a separately executable finite consistency checker. Earlier distribution theory and the unresolved full-text historical comparison are disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The sign-area bound, spectral profile, and rigidity are proved only for nonzero real degree-two spherical harmonics on the unit two-sphere under normalized area measure; the displayed stability coefficient is not asserted optimal.
title: Sharp sign-area bounds and spectral rigidity for quadratic spherical harmonics
